renders_heading: Brickland Weave 4-room design in four themes
renders_intro: Pick a theme to see the same Brickland Weave 4-room flat designed six ways: living, entrance, kitchen, dining, master bedroom and common bedroom. Every concept follows HDB's official 4-room Layout Ideas plan from the February 2023 sales brochure (approx. 93 sq m): living and dining at the end of the flat with a facade window, a household shelter by the entrance, a kitchen open to the dining area with a service yard beyond, a main bedroom with its own bath and two common bedrooms.
renders_note: AI concept designs for illustration only. Views and finishes are illustrative. Concept design by Maison, not the actual unit. Floor plan: HDB.
